independence.statement: No production implementation, Signal execution helpers, basis helpers, prior expectations, prior oracles, tests, model outputs, outcome labels, external APIs, web or network were used. JSON parsing, hash verification, row selection and arithmetic were independently performed with Python standard library. Only the source manifest and its explicitly listed definition, skill, source and qualification files were read. Existing files were not changed.
independence.source_qualification_limit: Qualification manifest membership and hash binding were checked. Referenced source-review and prior-oracle contents were not opened. Primary filings were not fetched or audited.

literal_exact_historical_skill_result.basis: Step 1 accepts company_facts or financials; all 57 sources are sec_company_facts and therefore excluded. Even an explicit source-type alias alone would not supply the per-concept legacy val objects required by step 2. No adapter/alias is stated in the two bound historical definition files.

required_normalization_not_in_bound_defi: Accept sec_company_facts as a financial source alias.

Read nested facts[] rows; identify exact concepts by tag, take value as the numeric operand, preserve end and unit, and use envelope company_id/cik/accession_number and availability rather than inventing per-row legacy fields.

historical_conflicts.resolution: Historical skill has no tie-breaking or restatement policy. Unresolved for this old date; it does not affect the latest-date operands.

ambiguities_and_limits: The exact historical input format and source-type filter do not support these actual sources; unconditional negative success would silently change the frozen definition.

The skill gives no rule for equal-end conflicting values, same-date restatement priority, unit conversion or mismatched-period selection. Latest operands here are unique, both USD, same end and nonzero denominator, so those latent gaps do not change the conditional arithmetic.

Skill company matching refers to accession prefix OR assumes document ownership when a fact has no company_id. Actual rows have neither company_id nor accn. Envelope company_id and cik establish identity for the source-only reading; the historical prefix rule is ambiguous for third-party filing accession prefixes and was not rewritten.

All underlying documents declare retrospective_api_extraction=true and requires_primary_filing_audit=true. available_at is a saved next-UTC-day policy based on filed date; this oracle checks the saved cutoff rather than independently proving historical publication or revision state.
Qualified local source coverage is finite. No claim is made that absent later facts do not exist elsewhere.

This oracle establishes bounded source reading and arithmetic only. It does not establish live model adherence, production stage completion, execution behavior, investment validity, reusable research gain or any outcome performance.

offset_convention.content: Zero-based half-open Unicode character offsets into decoded document.content, plus UTF-8 byte offsets. literal is the exact verbatim complete JSON object from that content.
offset_convention.serialized_file: Zero-based half-open character and UTF-8 byte offsets into the source envelope file; serialized_file_literal contains the escaped literal as physically written in that JSON string. This differs from the decoded content span.
